description: This is a React component for displaying and managing a table of API keys, including features like delete, regenerate, and view details.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of a key, including API call and updating local state.

methods.name: cancelDelete
methods.description: Closes the delete confirmation modal and resets related state.

methods.name: handleRegenerateClick
methods.description: Prepares and shows the regenerate key modal for a selected key.

methods.name: handleRegenerateFormChange
methods.description: Updates the regenerate form data state upon user input.

methods.name: handleRegenerateKey
methods.description: Validates and submits the regenerate key request, then updates local state with new key.
